t_advice_summary_textbox.text: try to reach the most points and accumulators by selecting which gnomes you think will collect the most mushrooms. they are all in a pair of two of the same corresponding colours and the same will be shown. one set leads to the dark forest and the other the light forest. its about luck but also skill.

vb_textbox.text: gfddfdsfgbh.stserof luftiurf tsom eht etacol ot yrt ot si si eht taht#Hello, I hope this is useful to you! For this task you are being ast to select coloured gnomes, your selection will lead you to a forest  of two different types. Here you will pick mushrooms and it is a part chance part skill on accumulating points on this area. Later in the game there is a luck of the draw accumulator to determine if the mushrooms found are multiplied, and whatever selection is shown is how much it is multiplied by. In the right hand corner there will be a counter for the points thus far gained. Remember Gnomes appear in fixed pairs, their positions may vary but they remain fixed in these pairs. orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple. One group, orange, green, red, and blue guide you to the bright forest, all the rest lead you to the dark forest. Your goal is to consistently score as highly as possible. Your selections will lead you a forest where you will be ast to pick mushrooms. It is your job to correctly guess which will be the forest that is the most harvesting of mushrooms. Here there will show a basket to collect it in, these will be red or yellow baskets dependant on which forest they belong to, Y dark and R bright forest. Then you are taken back to the town and an auto selection of accumulator points are added as a plus score e.g +5 and +1 which is added to the overall score. When choosing your selections you might want to consider patterns although these will change frequently.
